submissions.decision-lamp-survival-day-two: WITH RECURSIVE failure_days AS (SELECT exit_day, COUNT(*) AS failures FROM lamp_exits WHERE outcome = 'failed' AND exit_day <= 2 GROUP BY exit_day), steps AS (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY f.exit_day) AS step, f.failures, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lamp_exits AS e WHERE e.exit_day >= f.exit_day) AS at_risk FROM failure_days AS f), survival(step, probability) AS (SELECT 0, 1.0 UNION ALL SELECT s.step, p.probability * (s.at_risk - s.failures) / s.at_risk FROM survival AS p JOIN steps AS s ON s.step = p.step + 1) SELECT ROUND(probability, 6) AS survival_day_2 FROM survival ORDER BY step DESC LIMIT 1
submissions.decision-last-confirmed-shelf-before-inv: SELECT c.holding_code, n.shelf_code, n.slip_no FROM inventory_close AS c JOIN shelf_note AS n ON n.slip_no = (SELECT s.slip_no FROM shelf_note AS s WHERE s.holding_code = c.holding_code AND s.note_kind = 'sighted' AND s.note_day <= c.close_day ORDER BY s.note_day DESC, s.slip_no DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY c.holding_code ASC
submissions.decision-least-cost-dual-dealer-funding: SELECT a.ticket_code AS a_code, b.ticket_code AS b_code, a.price_cents + b.price_cents AS cost_cents, a.hold_cents + b.hold_cents AS hold_cents FROM funding_request AS r CROSS JOIN dealer_ticket AS a CROSS JOIN dealer_ticket AS b WHERE a.desk_code = 'A' AND b.desk_code = 'B' AND a.buy_units + b.buy_units = r.need_units AND a.delivery_day <= r.cutoff_day AND b.delivery_day <= r.cutoff_day AND a.hold_cents + b.hold_cents <= r.cap_cents ORDER BY cost_cents, a.ticket_code COLLATE BINARY, b.ticket_code COLLATE BINARY LIMIT 1
submissions.decision-least-cost-two-stage-finish: SELECT s.source_id AS sand_source, w.source_id AS wax_source, s.sand_cents + w.wax_cents + s.handling_cents + CASE WHEN s.source_id COLLATE BINARY = w.source_id THEN 0 ELSE w.handling_cents END AS total_cents, s.sand_hours + w.wax_hours AS total_hours FROM finish_quote AS s CROSS JOIN finish_quote AS w WHERE s.sand_cents IS NOT NULL AND w.wax_cents IS NOT NULL AND s.sand_hours + w.wax_hours <= 8 ORDER BY total_cents, total_hours, s.source_id COLLATE BINARY, w.source_id COLLATE BINARY LIMIT 1
